properties.name: easygram.update.webhook.url
properties.description: Public HTTPS URL that Telegram will POST updates to. Required when transport=WEBHOOK.

properties.name: easygram.update.webhook.path
properties.description: Local Spring MVC path that receives incoming webhook requests.

properties.name: easygram.update.webhook.secret-token
properties.description: Secret token validated in X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token header. Strongly recommended for production.

properties.name: easygram.update.webhook.max-connections
properties.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTPS connections from Telegram (1-100). Telegram default is 40.

properties.name: easygram.update.webhook.drop-pending-updates
properties.description: Drop pending updates when registering the webhook.

properties.name: easygram.update.webhook.unregister-on-shutdown
properties.description: Delete the webhook from Telegram on application shutdown.
